title: Fake CBI officer kept me on video call
description: A man called saying he was a CBI officer and that my Aadhaar was used for money laundering. He moved me to a video call with a person in police uniform, told me I was under digital arrest and must not tell my family. To clear my name I had to transfer Rs 3,50,000 to a 'verification account', which I did.

title: Video call police threatened arrest
description: Someone claiming to be from Mumbai police said a case was registered against me. They kept me on Skype for six hours, said I could not leave the room, and asked me to move all my savings to an RBI safe account for checking. I sent 2 lakh before realising it was fraud.

title: Told I was under investigation and to pay
description: I got a call that my phone number is linked to illegal activity. The caller connected me to a so-called senior officer on WhatsApp video who showed an arrest warrant. They said I was digitally arrested, monitored me continuously and made me transfer money for a refundable security check.

title: सीबीआई अधिकारी बनकर डिजिटल अरेस्ट
description: एक व्यक्ति ने खुद को सीबीआई अधिकारी बताया और कहा कि मेरे आधार से मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग हुई है। उसने वीडियो कॉल पर मुझे डिजिटल अरेस्ट में रखा और किसी को बताने से मना किया। जांच के नाम पर मुझसे 1,80,000 रुपये एक खाते में ट्रांसफर करवाए।

title: Police wale ne video call pe arrest bola
description: Ek aadmi ne call karke bola ki main police se hoon aur mere naam pe case hai. Usne video call pe uniform me officer dikhaya aur bola aap digital arrest me ho, ghar walon ko mat batana. Paisa verify karne ke liye safe account me transfer karwaya, maine 90,000 bhej diye.

title: Refund call asked me to approve request
description: I had complained about a failed order. A caller said he was from customer care and would send my refund. He sent a request on my UPI app and told me to enter my PIN to receive the refund. After I entered the PIN, Rs 12,000 was debited instead.

title: Entered UPI PIN to get money and lost it
description: Somebody posing as the shop's support team promised to return my money. They asked me to accept a collect request in PhonePe and type my UPI PIN so the amount could be credited. The money left my account; nothing was refunded.

title: Customer care fraud through collect request
description: While searching online for the courier helpline I called a number. The agent said a refund of Rs 499 was pending and I only needed to approve the payment request and enter the PIN. My account was debited Rs 24,999.

title: रिफंड के नाम पर पिन डलवाया
description: कस्टमर केयर बनकर एक व्यक्ति ने कहा कि मेरा रिफंड आएगा। उसने मेरे यूपीआई ऐप पर रिक्वेस्ट भेजी और पैसे पाने के लिए पिन डालने को कहा। पिन डालते ही मेरे खाते से 8,000 रुपये कट गए।

title: Refund ke liye PIN dalwaya
description: Customer care wale ne bola refund bhej raha hoon, app me request aayi hai use accept karo aur UPI PIN dalo. Maine PIN dala to paisa aane ki jagah mere account se 15,000 chale gaye.

title: SMS said account blocked, update KYC
description: I received an SMS that my bank account will be blocked today because KYC is pending. It had a link to update details. I opened it, entered my net banking login and the OTP, and soon Rs 40,000 was withdrawn.

title: KYC link stole my banking details
description: A message warned that my SBI YONO account was suspended and asked me to complete KYC through a link. The page looked like the bank site. After I filled in my user ID, password and OTP, several transactions happened without my consent.

title: Pending KYC message led to fraud
description: Got a text: dear customer your account will be closed, update PAN and KYC immediately at the link. I followed it and gave my card number and OTP. Money was taken from my account within minutes.

title: केवाईसी अपडेट के लिंक से धोखा
description: मुझे मैसेज आया कि आज मेरा बैंक खाता बंद हो जाएगा, केवाईसी अपडेट करें। लिंक पर क्लिक करके मैंने लॉगिन और ओटीपी डाला, उसके बाद मेरे खाते से 25,000 रुपये निकल गए।

title: KYC update ke naam pe link
description: SMS aaya ki account block ho jayega, KYC update karo is link pe. Maine link khol ke net banking id password aur OTP daal diya. Thodi der me account se paise nikal gaye.

title: Part-time job asked deposit to unlock tasks
description: On Telegram I was offered a part-time job liking YouTube videos for Rs 50 per task. After small payouts they moved me to 'prepaid tasks' where I had to deposit money to unlock higher commission. My balance showed profits but I could not withdraw unless I paid more. I lost 1.2 lakh.

title: Work from home rating tasks fraud
description: A WhatsApp recruiter offered online work rating hotels. The first tasks paid a little, then I had to recharge my task account to continue. Each level demanded a bigger deposit and the withdrawal was frozen with a 'tax' demand.

title: Online task job, could not withdraw earnings
description: I joined an online job group doing simple review tasks. They said my account had a negative balance and I must top up to release my earnings. I kept paying and never got anything back.

title: यूट्यूब लाइक करने की पार्ट टाइम नौकरी
description: टेलीग्राम पर यूट्यूब वीडियो लाइक करने की पार्ट टाइम नौकरी का ऑफर आया। शुरुआत में थोड़े पैसे मिले, फिर टास्क अनलॉक करने के लिए पैसे जमा करने को कहा गया। कमाई निकालने के लिए और पैसे मांगते रहे, मेरे 60,000 रुपये डूब गए।

title: Task wali job me paise phas gaye
description: WhatsApp pe part time job mili, video like karne ka kaam tha. Pehle 150 rupaye mile phir bole agla task unlock karne ke liye 5,000 deposit karo. Withdrawal ke time aur paise maangne lage.

title: Stock tips group with fake trading app
description: I was added to a WhatsApp group giving stock market tips. They asked me to install a trading app and invest through it. The app showed huge profits, but when I tried to withdraw they asked for a 20 percent service fee first. I invested 6 lakh in total.

title: Investment app shows profit, no withdrawal
description: An 'investment advisor' on Instagram guided me to buy IPO shares through their platform. My dashboard showed my money doubling. Withdrawal requests were rejected and they demanded tax to release funds.

title: Fake share trading platform
description: After joining a stock trading class on Telegram, the mentor told us to trade on a special institutional account app. Profits looked real in the app but I could never take the money out, and the group was deleted later.

title: शेयर बाजार ग्रुप और नकली ऐप
description: व्हाट्सएप ग्रुप में शेयर बाजार के टिप्स दिए जाते थे और एक ट्रेडिंग ऐप में पैसा लगाने को कहा गया। ऐप में बहुत मुनाफा दिखा लेकिन पैसे निकालने पर पहले फीस मांगी गई। मेरे 3 लाख रुपये फंस गए।

title: Trading app me profit dikha par withdrawal nahi
description: Stock tips wale group ne ek app download karwaya. App me profit double dikh raha tha, par withdraw karne gaye to bole pehle 15 percent tax bharo. Maine 2 lakh lagaye the.

title: Video call recorded and used to blackmail
description: I received a WhatsApp video call from an unknown woman. The screen showed obscene content and the call was recorded. Later they sent me an edited video and threatened to send it to my contacts and post it online unless I paid 50,000.

title: Blackmailed with morphed video after call
description: A stranger video called me late at night. Next day I got a clip of my face with explicit material and a message saying they would share it with my family and on YouTube. They demanded money to delete it.

title: Threat to leak recorded video call
description: After a short video chat with someone I met on Facebook, they said they had recorded me and would leak the video to my friends list. Then another man called pretending to be a police officer asking money to settle the matter.

title: वीडियो कॉल रिकॉर्ड करके ब्लैकमेल
description: एक अनजान नंबर से वीडियो कॉल आई जिसमें अश्लील वीडियो चल रहा था। बाद में उन्होंने मेरा एडिट किया हुआ वीडियो भेजा और धमकी दी कि पैसे नहीं दिए तो रिश्तेदारों को भेज देंगे।

title: Video call record karke dhamki
description: Raat ko ek ladki ka video call aaya, kuch second me kaat diya. Fir unhone mera video edit karke bheja aur bola 30,000 do warna sabko bhej denge aur YouTube pe daal denge.

title: Electricity cut threat with helpline number
description: I got an SMS that my electricity connection would be disconnected tonight because the last bill was not updated, and to call the officer's number. The caller asked me to install an app for verification and pay Rs 10. Afterwards Rs 49,000 was taken from my account.

title: Power disconnection message fraud
description: A text from 'electricity department' said my power would be cut at 9:30 pm. On calling, the man made me download a support app and make a small payment. He got access to my phone and emptied my account.

title: Fake bill update call
description: Message said dear consumer your electricity bill is pending, connection will be cut today. The person on the phone told me to install a remote app to update the bill and then used my banking app.

title: बिजली कटने का मैसेज
description: मैसेज आया कि आज रात बिजली कनेक्शन काट दिया जाएगा, बिल अपडेट नहीं है, इस नंबर पर कॉल करें। कॉल करने पर एक ऐप डाउनलोड करवाया और 10 रुपये भेजने को कहा, फिर खाते से 30,000 रुपये कट गए।

title: Bijli cut hone ka SMS aur app
description: SMS aaya ki bijli aaj raat kat jayegi, bill update karo. Call kiya to bola ye app install karo aur 10 rupaye pay karo. Uske baad mere account se paise nikal gaye.

title: Courier parcel with drugs in my name
description: A call said a FedEx parcel booked in my name was seized at Mumbai airport with drugs and fake passports. They transferred the call to 'narcotics police' who said I must pay to avoid arrest and to verify my bank accounts.

title: Parcel seized at customs, asked to pay
description: An automated call from the courier company said my parcel was held. The agent then said it contained illegal items and connected me to a customs officer, who demanded a clearance payment and threatened legal action.

title: Illegal items found in package
description: Someone said they were from DHL and that a package to Taiwan sent with my Aadhaar had MDMA in it. They forced me to share my screen and pay a 'settlement' to the officer to keep my name out of the case.

title: कूरियर पार्सल में ड्रग्स
description: कॉल आया कि मेरे नाम से भेजे गए फेडेक्स पार्सल में ड्रग्स मिले हैं। फिर नारकोटिक्स पुलिस से बात करवाई जिसने गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए पैसे मांगे।

title: Parcel me drugs mile bol ke paise
description: Courier wale ka call aaya ki aapke parcel me drugs aur passport mile hain. Fir customs officer ne bola case band karne ke liye paisa bhejo.

title: Lottery prize needed processing fee
description: I got a WhatsApp message that I had won 25 lakh in the KBC lucky draw. To receive the prize I had to pay processing and GST charges. I paid three times and they kept asking for more.

title: Won a car in lucky draw, paid charges
description: A caller said my number won a car in a company lucky draw. Registration, insurance and transport fees had to be paid before delivery. After paying 40,000 there was no car and no reply.

title: Prize money release fee
description: An email said I had won an international lottery and needed to pay a clearance fee to release the prize amount. I transferred the fee and was then asked for an anti-terror certificate fee.

title: लॉटरी जीतने के नाम पर फीस
description: व्हाट्सएप पर मैसेज आया कि मैंने केबीसी लॉटरी में 25 लाख जीते हैं। इनाम पाने के लिए प्रोसेसिंग फीस और टैक्स भरने को कहा। मैंने कई बार पैसे भेजे।

title: Lucky draw prize ke liye fees
description: Call aaya ki aapne lucky draw me inaam jeeta hai, pehle registration fee aur GST bharo. Maine 20,000 bhar diye phir bhi aur paise maang rahe hain.

title: Bank caller asked for OTP
description: A person called saying he was from my bank's card department and my credit card would be blocked. He asked me to tell him the OTP that came on my phone to keep it active. After I shared it, a purchase of Rs 35,000 was made.

title: Shared OTP with fake bank executive
description: Caller claimed to be a bank official upgrading my debit card. He knew my name and card number and asked for the OTP to complete the upgrade. Money was debited right after.

title: Credit limit increase call took OTP
description: Someone offered to increase my credit card limit and said I would get a code to confirm. I read out the code; it was an OTP for a transaction and my card was charged.

title: बैंक अधिकारी बनकर ओटीपी लिया
description: एक व्यक्ति ने बैंक से बताकर कहा कि मेरा कार्ड बंद हो जाएगा। उसने मोबाइल पर आया ओटीपी पूछा, मैंने बता दिया और मेरे कार्ड से 20,000 रुपये की खरीदारी हो गई।

title: Bank wale ne OTP pucha
description: Bank se call hai bol ke card band hone ki baat ki aur OTP poocha. Maine OTP bata diya, turant card se paisa kat gaya.

title: Army buyer on OLX sent QR code
description: I listed my sofa on OLX. A buyer said he was an army officer being transferred and would pay in advance. He sent a QR code and asked me to scan it to receive the money. Scanning and entering my PIN took 15,000 from me.

title: Fake army officer buying my bike
description: A man claiming to be in the CRPF agreed to buy my bike from a classifieds site. He said army payments work differently and asked me to send Rs 1 first to verify, then larger amounts which he promised to return double.

title: Marketplace buyer scam with QR
description: Selling a fridge on Facebook Marketplace, the buyer sent a QR code saying it would credit the advance. When I scanned it, money was debited from my account. He said he was posted at the army cantonment.

title: ओएलएक्स पर फौजी बनकर खरीदार
description: ओएलएक्स पर सामान बेचने डाला तो एक व्यक्ति ने खुद को आर्मी अफसर बताया। उसने पैसे भेजने के लिए क्यूआर कोड भेजा, स्कैन करते ही मेरे खाते से पैसे कट गए।

title: OLX buyer army wala QR code
description: OLX pe phone becha, buyer bola main army me hoon, QR code scan karo paise aa jayenge. Scan karke PIN dala to mere hi paise chale gaye.

title: Instant loan app harassing with morphed photos
description: I took a small loan from an instant loan app. They accessed my contacts and gallery. Even after repayment they demanded more, sent morphed obscene photos of me to my relatives and threatened to make them viral.

title: Loan app recovery agents threats
description: A quick loan app gave me 3,000 for 7 days and cut heavy charges. Recovery agents call and abuse my family and colleagues and send messages calling me a fraud, demanding several times the amount.

title: Harassment after app loan
description: After downloading a loan app that I never even used fully, they started calling all my contacts saying I am a defaulter and threatened to circulate edited photos unless I pay.

title: लोन ऐप से उत्पीड़न
description: मैंने एक इंस्टेंट लोन ऐप से छोटा लोन लिया। चुकाने के बाद भी वे और पैसे मांग रहे हैं और मेरी एडिट की हुई फोटो रिश्तेदारों को भेजकर बदनाम करने की धमकी दे रहे हैं।

title: Loan app wale photo viral karne ki dhamki
description: Loan app se 5,000 liye the, wapas bhi kar diye. Ab wo contacts ko call karke gaali dete hain aur meri morph photo viral karne ki dhamki de rahe hain.

title: Order delivered late
description: My online order was delivered five days late and the box was damaged. The seller has not responded to my complaint about a replacement.

title: ATM did not dispense cash
description: I tried to withdraw 5,000 from an ATM. The machine did not give cash but the amount was debited. The bank says the reversal will take seven working days.

title: नेटवर्क की समस्या
description: पिछले एक हफ्ते से मेरे मोबाइल में नेटवर्क नहीं आ रहा है और कस्टमर केयर कोई समाधान नहीं दे रहा।

title: Neighbour parking dispute
description: My neighbour parks his car in front of my gate every day and I cannot take my vehicle out in the morning.

title: Refund pending from airline
description: Flight cancel hui thi, airline ne refund 30 din me dene ka bola tha, 2 mahine ho gaye abhi tak nahi aaya.

title: Lost my wallet in the bus
description: I lost my wallet with my driving licence and some cash while travelling in a city bus yesterday evening.

title: Wrong electricity reading
description: The meter reading on my electricity bill is much higher than actual usage. I visited the office and they asked me to submit a written complaint.

title: स्ट्रीट लाइट खराब
description: हमारी गली की स्ट्रीट लाइट एक महीने से खराब है और रात में बहुत अंधेरा रहता है।

title: Duplicate charge by shop
description: A shop charged my card twice for the same purchase. The shop owner agreed and said he will refund one payment by next week.

title: Gas cylinder delivery late
description: Gas cylinder book kiye 10 din ho gaye, agency wale bolte hain kal aayega par abhi tak delivery nahi hui.

title: Unknown call asking my name
description: I got a call from an unknown number asking if I am the account holder and then the call dropped.

title: Strange message with a link
description: I received a message with a link about a prize but I did not open it. I want to know if it is safe.

title: Unknown video call
description: Raat ko unknown number se video call aaya, maine uthaya nahi. Kya ye fraud ho sakta hai?

title: Someone asked about my parcel
description: A person called asking whether I had sent any parcel recently and hung up when I asked who he was.

title: Investment advice offer
description: A person on LinkedIn offered investment guidance and asked for my WhatsApp number. I have not invested anything.

title: बैंक के नाम से कॉल
description: बैंक के नाम से एक कॉल आया था लेकिन मैंने कोई जानकारी नहीं दी और फोन काट दिया।
